arxiv-2111-12629.title: WFDefProxy: Modularly Implementing and Empirically Evaluating Website Fingerprinting Defenses
arxiv-2111-12629.creator: Jiajun Gong, Wuqi Zhang, Charles Zhang, Tao Wang
arxiv-2111-12629.description: Abstract Tor, an onion-routing anonymity network, has been shown to be vulnerable to Website Fingerprinting (WF), which de-anonymizes web browsing by analyzing the unique characteristics of the encrypted network traffic. Although many defenses have been proposed, few have been implemented and tested in the real world; others were only simulated.

arxiv-2111-13121.title: An optimization model for renewal scheduling and traffic flow routing
arxiv-2111-13121.creator: Tomas Lidén, Martin Aronsson
arxiv-2111-13121.description: Abstract This document is the third sub-report from the research project SATT (Samplanering av trafikpåverkande åtgärder och trafikflöden, modellstudie / Coordinated planning of temporary capacity restrictions and traffic flows, model study). The report summarizes the modelling alternatives that have been considered.

arxiv-2307-16154.title: Testing the validity of the surface approximation for reactions induced by weakly bound nuclei with a fully quantum-mechanical model
arxiv-2307-16154.creator: Junzhe Liu, Jin Lei, Zhongzhou Ren
arxiv-2307-16154.description: Abstract We examine the validity of surface approximation for breakup reactions using a fully quantum-mechanical model proposed by Ichimura, Austern, and Vincent (IAV). Analogous to the semi-classical picture, we introduce radial cut-offs to scattering waves in the IAV framework, which we refer to as IAV-cut.

arxiv-2411-15742.title: PEnG: Pose-Enhanced Geo-Localisation
arxiv-2411-15742.creator: Tavis Shore, Oscar Mendez, Simon Hadfield
arxiv-2411-15742.description: Abstract Cross-view Geo-localisation is typically performed at a coarse granularity, because densely sampled satellite image patches overlap heavily. This heavy overlap would make disambiguating patches very challenging. However, by opting for sparsely sampled patches, prior work has placed an artificial upper bound on the localisation accuracy that is possible.

arxiv-2504-16920.title: Summary statistics of learning link changing neural representations to behavior
arxiv-2504-16920.creator: Jacob A. Zavatone-Veth, Blake Bordelon, Cengiz Pehlevan
arxiv-2504-16920.description: Abstract How can we make sense of large-scale recordings of neural activity across learning? Theories of neural network learning with their origins in statistical physics offer a potential answer: for a given task, there are often a small set of summary statistics that are sufficient to predict performance as the network learns.

arxiv-2505-23635.title: Expressivity of bisimulation pseudometrics over analytic state spaces
arxiv-2505-23635.creator: Daniel Luckhardt, Harsh Beohar, Clemens Kupke
arxiv-2505-23635.description: Abstract A Markov decision process (MDP) is a state-based dynamical system capable of describing probabilistic behaviour with rewards. In this paper, we view MDPs as coalgebras living in the category of analytic spaces, a very general class of measurable spaces. Note that analytic spaces were already studied in the literature on labelled Markov processes and bisimulation relations. color=red!40 color=red!

arxiv-2510-10639.title: Automatic Piecewise Linear Regression for Predicting Student Learning Satisfaction
arxiv-2510-10639.creator: Haemin Choi, Gayathri Nadarajan
arxiv-2510-10639.description: Abstract Although student learning satisfaction has been widely studied, modern techniques such as interpretable machine learning and neural networks have not been sufficiently explored. This study demonstrates that a recent model that combines boosting with interpretability, automatic piecewise linear regression (APLR), offers the best fit for predicting learning satisfaction among several state-of-the-art approaches.

arxiv-2511-03241.title: A unified physics-informed generative operator framework for general inverse problems
arxiv-2511-03241.creator: Gang Bao, Yaohua Zang
arxiv-2511-03241.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Gang Bao, Yaohua Zang. Solving inverse problems governed by partial differential equations (PDEs) is central to science and engineering, yet remains challenging when measurements are sparse, noisy, or when the underlying coefficients are high-dimensional or discontinuous. Existing deep learning approaches either require extensive labeled datasets or are limited to specific measurement types, often leading to failure in such regimes and restricting their practical applicability. Here, a novel generative neural operator framework, IGNO, is introduced to overcome these limitations.

pmc-10650309.title: Target-Guided Isolation and Purification of Antioxidants from Urtica laetevirens Maxim. by HSCCC Combined with Online DPPH-HPLC Analysis
pmc-10650309.creator: Aijing Li, Mencuo La, Huichun Wang, Jianzhong Zhao, Yao Wang, Ruisha Mian, Fangfang He, Yuhan Wang, Tingqin Yang, Denglang Zou, Laura De Martino
pmc-10650309.description: Urtica laetevirens Maxim. is used extensively in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) for its potent antioxidative properties. In this study, three antioxidants were purified from U. laetevirens. using HSCCC guided by online DPPH-HPLC analysis. Firstly, the online DPPH-HPLC analysis was performed to profile out the antioxidant active molecules in U. laetevirens.

pmc-10774623.title: Excimer Laser System: The Revolutionary Way to Treat Psoriasis
pmc-10774623.creator: Abdullah Alyoussef
pmc-10774623.description: Psoriasis is a chronic, autoinflammatory skin disease that affects approximately 100 million people worldwide. It is a systemic disease characterized by scaly, red patches on the skin and can also affect the joints. Psoriasis can significantly affect a person's physical and mental health.

pmc-11457444.title: Regularity and correlation analysis of regional lymph node metastasis in nonoperative patients with non-small cell lung cancer based on positron emission tomography/computed tomography images
pmc-11457444.creator: Feifan Sun, Zhiming Chen, Daijun Zhou, Zhihui Li, Haoyang Wang, Rong Zhao, Jing Xian, Jingjing Peng, Xingchen Peng, Chaoyang Jiang, Mei Shi, Dong Li
pmc-11457444.description: BackgroundDefinitive concurrent chemoradiotherapy (CCRT) is the standard treatment for locally advanced, inoperable non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). Previous studies have mainly focused on examining local failure and recurrence patterns after surgery and the principles of lymph node metastasis (LNM) in surgical candidates with NSCLC.

pmc-11634805.title: Efficacy of IVUS-guided stent implantation in patients with complex CAD: a meta-analysis based on RCTs
pmc-11634805.creator: Anyi Xu, Dongying Wang, Bangsheng Chen, Siyue Song, Qiufeng Zhang, Zuokun Zhu, Min Dai, Chenyi Wang
pmc-11634805.description: BackgroundThis study is to investigate the efficacy of stent implantation in patients with complex coronary artery disease (CAD) under intravascular ultrasound (IVUS) guidance and non-IVUS guidance.MethodsWe conducted a systematic search in PubMed, Web of Science, Cochran, and Embase for the articles of IVUS-guided and non-IVUS-guided stent implantation in patients with complex CAD and reported related outcomes.

pmc-11692463.title: EXPLORING CENTRAL SYMPTOMS OF SUBTHRESHOLD DEPRESSION IN OLDER ADULTS: A NETWORK ANALYSIS
pmc-11692463.creator: Rendong He, Li Chen, Yiming Qiu, Junxin Li
pmc-11692463.description: Subthreshold depression (StD), a precursor to major depressive disorder, has not been well studied in older adults. Identifying central symptoms among various symptoms within the mental disorders enhances understanding of mental disorder structures and informs prevention strategies. We investigated the central symptoms of StD in community-dwelling older adults in China in a cross-sectional study.

pmc-12656420.creator: Leqing Lin, Haoyang Lin, Guantian Hong, Jianfeng He, Lihao Wang, Ruobin Zhuang, Wenguo Zhu, Yongchun Zhong, Jianhui Yu, Huadan Zheng, Tae Geun Kim

A 2.3 μm distributed feedback (DFB) diode laser targeting the CO absorption line at 4300.699 cm−1 was employed, offering strong line intensity and minimal interference from H2O, CO2, NO2, and SO2. The optimal modulation depth of 0.

pmc-12987342.title: Data-Driven Remaining Useful Life Prediction for Pt–Rh Thermocouples Using an Extended Kalman Filter
pmc-12987342.creator: Na Li, Siyang Dai, Yi Liu, Yunlong Zhu, Jitao Li, Xiaojin Huang
pmc-12987342.description: Platinum (Pt)–Rhodium (Rh) thermocouples are widely used in industrial processes such as chemical and nuclear power production, serving as one of the most common temperature measuring instruments and playing a vital role in real-time condition monitoring. However, the measurement accuracy can be affected by harsh high-temperature operating environments, which may cause measurement drift or even functional failure.

pmc-13305761.title: P15 Bacteriological profile and antimicrobial resistance trends in chronic suppurative otitis media (CSOM) in India: comprehensive review (1961–2026)
pmc-13305761.creator: Saurabh Varshney, Pratima Gupta, Shyam Kishor Kumar, Aroop Mohanty, Mithilesh Kumar Jha, Minakshi Singh
pmc-13305761.description: BackgroundChronic suppurative otitis media (CSOM), characterized by persistent middle ear suppuration through tympanic membrane perforation for ≥2 weeks, remains a major public health challenge in India with prevalence ranging from 1.4% to 14.7%, classifying India as a WHO high-prevalence zone. The earliest CSOM study from Uttar Pradesh in 1961 reported 14.7% prevalence among schoolchildren.

pmc-13326313.title: The relationship between aging anxiety, job stress and psychological resilience in oncology nurses: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13326313.creator: Nilüfer Eroğlu, Nilgün Kuru Alici
pmc-13326313.description: BackgroundCancer is one of the leading causes of death worldwide. Oncology nurses play an essential role in the care of oncology patients. Providing care for cancer patients and managing complex treatment processes can be challenging for oncology nurses. The psychological effects of caring for cancer patients and facing their illness and death are often overlooked.

pmc-13604426.title: Geometry-Tunable Nanoneedle Arrays Reveal Membrane Penetration Mechanics for Intracellular Delivery
pmc-13604426.creator: Xuanhe Zhang, Zheng Wang, Yiqing Chen, Lele Song, Yuan Ma, Jiadao Wang
pmc-13604426.description: Nanoneedle arrays provide a promising interface for intracellular delivery, yet scalable control of array geometry and membrane penetration mechanics remains insufficiently understood. Here, we developed a rapid and scalable strategy for fabricating geometry-tunable silicon nanoneedle arrays. One-step SF6/O2 etching produced ordered arrays with center-to-center spacing of 1–5 μm, whereas pseudo-Bosch etching produced high-aspect-ratio (HAR) nanoneedles.

uslaw-usc-t42-s1353.title: 42 U.S.C. § 1353 — Payments to States
uslaw-usc-t42-s1353.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s1353.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 7 (Social Security); Subchapter XIV (Grants To States For Aid To Permanently And Totally Disabled). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) From the sums appropriated therefor, the Secretary of the Treasury shall pay to each State which has an approved plan for aid to the permanently and totally disabled, for each.

uslaw-usc-t50-s2353.title: 50 U.S.C. § 2353 — Comprehensive preparedness program
uslaw-usc-t50-s2353.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t50-s2353.description: United States Code, Title 50 (War And National Defense); Chapter 40 (Defense Against Weapons Of Mass Destruction); Subchapter IV (Coordination Of Policy And Countermeasures Against Proliferation Of Weapons Of Mass Destruction). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Program required The President, acting through the Committee on Nonproliferation established under section 2352 of this title, shall develop a comprehensive program for carrying out.
